correctness.rationale: Renewal from zero gives the Gaussian age mixture and the reset covariance 2∫exp(−ru) exp(−Ku) D exp(−Kᵀu)du. The integrand is strictly positive definite at finite u, so C₁, C₂ and Δ=C₁−C₂ are strictly positive definite. The two stable Lyapunov equations subtract to KΔ+ΔKᵀ=Q; in dimension two every possible antisymmetric part of KΔ is ωJ, and the first equation then fixes D. With M=Δ⁻¹C₁ the off-diagonal slope of D is (JM−MᵀJ)₁₂/2=(M₂₂−M₁₁)/2. The single linear equality and the strict inequalities tr(K)>0, det(K)>0 and Dᵢᵢ>0 yield the complete fiber, including infeasible h=0,d₀≠0; uniqueness of each stable Lyapunov solution proves sufficiency. As a check of this infeasible branch, take r₁=1,r₂=2, Δ=I and C₁ with diagonal 2 and off-diagonal 1/2, C₂=C₁−I. All covariance order checks pass, but h=0 and d₀=3/4. Unequal diagonal damping gives nonzero h, and the covariance as a function of parameters is rational, so the exceptional algebraic condition is nontrivial. In the blind family, whitening by D⁻¹/² gives damping κI plus a skew matrix, so the age-specific covariance is (1−exp(−2κt))D/κ, independent of rotation. The resulting exponential mixture gives the full one-time equality and the stated C_r, whereas unreset stationary circulation is controlled by K(D/κ)−(D/κ)Kᵀ=2ωJ/κ. The supplied exact-rational checker was inspected, not run; its finite covariance checks cannot prove the entire inverse or equality of full laws.
residual_risks: The claim is for exact full matrices and known positive rates, diagonal positive diffusion, stable planar drift, and resets to zero. No temporal-law blindness, noisy identifiability, or uniform conditioning near h=0 is implied.
